arabic text:
MAI KIS TARHA SE NIKALOON BADAN SE JAAN-E-HUSSAIN
BAHOT HI SAKHT HAI YA RAB YE IMTEHAN-E-HUSSAIN
english translation text:
HOW CAN I DRAW THE SOUL OF HUSSAIN FROM HIS BLESSED BODY
O LORD, THIS TRIAL OF HUSSAIN IS SO VERY SEVERE

arabic text:
LAGA HAI ZAKHM-E-TABAR, BEH RAHA HAI SAR SE LAHOO
BHARE HAIN KHOON MEIN JAAN-E-RASOOL KE GESU
QAREEB JAAKE RAKHUN DIL PE KIS TARHA QABOO
KE IS LAHOO MEIN TO HAI FATEMA KE DOODH KI BOO
english translation text:
THE AXE HAS WOUNDED HIM; BLOOD FLOWS FROM HIS HEAD
THE LOCKS OF THE PROPHET'S BELOVED ARE DRENCHED IN BLOOD
HOW CAN I KEEP CONTROL OF MY HEART WHEN I GO NEAR
WHEN IN THIS BLOOD IS THE SCENT OF FATEMA'S MILK

arabic text:
MAI PHIR IN AANKHON PE DHAAOON SITAM YE KYA HAI ZAROOR
BICHAR KE WO ALI AKBAR SE HOGAYI BE-NOOR
NIDA YE AAYI DAHAN SE NIKAAL JAAN-E-HUZOOR
KAHA DAHAN MEIN TO KAANTE PADE HAIN RABB-E-GHAFOOR
english translation text:
MUST I NOW INFLICT THIS CRUELTY UPON THOSE EYES
THEY LOST THEIR LIGHT WHEN THEY WERE PARTED FROM ALI AKBAR
THE CALL CAME: DRAW THE SOUL FROM HIS BLESSED MOUTH
HE SAID: O FORGIVING LORD, THORNS ARE LODGED IN THAT MOUTH

arabic text:
NIDA YE AAYI KE GARDAN SE KHAINCH JAAN INKI
KAHA MAI KYA KAROON GARDAN PE CHAL RAHI HAI CHURI
CHURI PAKAD KE YE CHILLATI HAI KOI BIBI
NA ZIBHA KAR MERE BACHE KO MAI DUA DUNGI
english translation text:
THE CALL CAME: DRAW HIS SOUL FROM THE NECK
HE SAID: WHAT CAN I DO? THE KNIFE IS MOVING ACROSS HIS NECK
A LADY IS CLUTCHING THE KNIFE AND CRYING OUT
DO NOT SLAUGHTER MY CHILD; I WILL PRAY FOR YOU

arabic text:
NIDA YE AAYI KE SEENE SE QABZ KAR LE JAAN
KAHA WO TEERON SE CHALNI HAI AY MERE REHMAN
ABHI TO MAAR KE BARCHI HATA THA EK SHAITAN
AUR AB TO HAI TAH-E-ZANU-E-SHIMR YE QURAN
english translation text:
THE CALL CAME: SEIZE THE SOUL FROM HIS CHEST
HE SAID: IT IS PIERCED THROUGH WITH ARROWS, O MY MERCIFUL LORD
JUST NOW A DEVIL STRUCK HIM WITH A SPEAR AND MOVED AWAY
AND NOW THIS LIVING QURAN LIES BENEATH THE KNEE OF SHIMR

arabic text:
NIDA YE AAYI KE MAZLOOMIYAT KE RUTBA-SHINAAS
KAMAR SE KHAINCH LE SAABIR KI JAAN BE-WASWAS
KAHA MALAK NE TADAP KE, BA-DARD-O-HASRAT-O-YAAS
KAMAR TO TOOT GAYI JAB SE MAR GAYE ABBAS
english translation text:
THE CALL CAME: O ONE WHO KNOWS THE RANKS OF OPPRESSION
DRAW THE SOUL OF THE PATIENT ONE FROM HIS BACK WITHOUT HESITATION
THE ANGEL CRIED OUT, TREMBLING WITH PAIN, LONGING, AND DESPAIR
HIS BACK HAS BEEN BROKEN EVER SINCE ABBAS WAS MARTYRED

arabic text:
MUTEE-E-HUKM HOON PAR FIKR HAI AY YAZDAN
HAR EK UZV HAI ZAKHMI, LAGAOON HAATH KAHAN
KHUDA PUKARA: YE MUSHKIL KARENGE HUM AASAN
NA TU NIKAAL MERE AASHIQ-E-GHAREEB KI JAAN
english translation text:
I AM OBEDIENT TO YOUR COMMAND, BUT I AM TROUBLED, O LORD
EVERY LIMB IS WOUNDED; WHERE CAN I PLACE MY HAND
GOD CALLED: I WILL MAKE THIS DIFFICULTY EASY
YOU SHALL NOT TAKE THE SOUL OF MY LONELY BELOVED

arabic text:
MAI KHUD NIKAAL RAHA HOON BADAN SE JAAN-E-HUSSAIN
KE KHATM HONE KO AB HAI YE IMTEHAN-E-HUSSAIN
english translation text:
I MYSELF AM DRAWING THE SOUL OF HUSSAIN FROM HIS BLESSED BODY
FOR NOW THIS TRIAL OF HUSSAIN IS COMING TO AN END
